in_sanskrit.name: अस्त्रेय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds or wields powerful weapons, a warrior deity.

in_hindi.name: अस्त्रेय
in_hindi.long_meaning: Slayer of demons, a divine warrior.

in_tamil.name: அஸ்திரேய
in_tamil.long_meaning: He who holds or uses a bow and arrow (astam) or other weapons, a warrior deity.

in_telugu.name: అస్థేయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who shines like a weapon or has the power to destroy, a divine warrior.

in_marathi.name: Astreya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Stars
in_marathi.long_meaning: Astreya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Astreya is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'astra' which means 'star'. In Hindu mythology, Astreya is known as the deity of stars and planets, and is often invoked for protection and guidance. He is also revered as the patron god of astronomers, astrologers, and scholars.
